title: 第9章 什么女神舔狗罢了第10章 初战
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
沈无名不想和曹茱萸纠缠，所以看到她就选择了跑路。
在房中喝了两杯茶，估摸着曹茱萸应该走了，他这才施施然走回来。
结果转角处一个没注意，就撞在一团绵软上，很大很软很绵很弹。
嘭！
曹茱萸捂着胸口，满脸惊喜地看着他，“你终于回来了！”
“啊？”沈无名后背发凉，下意识就想跑路，不过想想，这好像就是自己家。
“你怎么在这里？”他一脸防备地问道。
“来找你呀！”曹茱萸说了一声，眼神都亮了起来。
马宝山和众人本就恋恋不舍，有意无意地瞥向曹茱萸。
这会儿全都停留在沈无名身上。
每个人都脸色阴沉，目光嫉妒，马宝山更是露出愤恨之色。
他们的女神找沈无名干什么？
而且他们都看到了，原本曹茱萸脸色清淡，对谁都是爱搭不理的模样。
但是走到沈无名面前，立刻就变得热切殷勤。
沈无名也感受到了那些如刀剑般的目光，心中暗吸一口冷气，随即就摇手拒绝。
“我不是说了我要考虑一段时间吗？你先回去吧。”
“不不不。”曹茱萸摆了摆手，“我知道你要考虑，我不是来催这件事的！”
“督造司最近有个麻烦，一直没能解决，我今天回去后突然想起，你或许有办法。”
“所以我想请你帮我去看看。”
沈无名摇了摇头，这个女人实在太主动了，他有些招架不住。

脑子飞速运转，正在编借口，曹茱萸就抓住他的手撒娇道：“你就帮帮我嘛。”
这一幕，让所有人都一脸震惊，老一辈的人都面带惊讶，难以置信。
曹茱萸的高冷是众所周知的，怎么……在沈无名面前这么撒娇？
以前甚至没有男人能靠近她一尺之内，可此时，她居然主动去牵沈无名的手。
沈无名感受到光滑温软的小手，还有时不时碰到胳膊的肉弹，忍不住心猿意马。
此时楚平山大步上前，沈无名回过神来，没忘了自己是有妇之夫。
“无名，督造司的事情有点麻烦，你要是有办法，就帮帮忙。”
楚平山可是沈无名的饭票，他都出面了，沈无名自然也不好拒绝。
只能跟着曹茱萸去督造司。
如果他走之后，整个寿亭侯府都陷入了沸腾。
这沈无名到底哪里讨人喜欢？
先是拿下了中山四大美人之一的楚幼仪，又让四大美人之二的曹茱萸如此主动？
一向骄傲的曹茱萸，那可是中山官场上的后起之秀。
content_en:
Shen Wuming didn't want to get entangled with Cao Zhuyu, so he chose to run away when he saw her.
After drinking two cups of tea in the room, he estimated that Cao Juyu should leave, and then Shi Shiran came back.
As a result, someone didn't pay attention at the corner and bumped into a soft ball. It was very big, soft, spongy and elastic.
Bang!
Cao Zhuyu covered her chest and looked at him with surprise, "You are finally back!"
"Ah?" Shen Wuming's back felt cold, and he subconsciously wanted to run away, but thinking about it, this seemed to be his home.
"Why are you here?" he asked defensively.
"Coming to find you!" Cao Zhuyu said, her eyes lighting up.
Ma Baoshan and the others were reluctant to leave, and glanced at Cao Juyu intentionally or unintentionally.
At this moment, everything was focused on Shen Wuming.
Everyone's face was gloomy and their eyes were jealous, and Ma Baoshan even showed resentment.
What does their goddess want from Shen Wuming?
And they all saw that Cao Juyu originally had a calm face and seemed to be indifferent to everyone.
But when he walked in front of Shen Wuming, he immediately became eager and attentive.
Shen Wuming also felt those sword-like gazes, took a breath of air in his heart, and then waved his hand to refuse.
"Didn't I say that I have to think about it for a while? You should go back first."
"No, no, no." Cao Zhuyu waved her hand, "I know you want to consider it, I'm not here to rush this matter!"
"The Superintendent has a problem recently that has not been solved. After I went back today, I suddenly remembered that you might have a solution."
"So I want to ask you to help me go and take a look."
Shen Wuming shook his head. This woman was so proactive that he couldn't resist her.
His mind was racing and he was making up excuses when Cao Zhuyu grabbed his hand and said coquettishly: "Just help me."
This scene shocked everyone, and the older generation looked surprised and unbelievable.
Cao Juyu is well known for her aloofness, why... is she acting so coquettishly in front of Shen Wuming?
In the past, no man could even come within one foot of her, but now, she actually took the initiative to hold Shen Wuming's hand.
Shen Wuming felt the smooth and soft little hands, as well as the flesh bullets that occasionally touched his arms, and couldn't help but feel distracted.
At this time, Chu Pingshan strode forward, and Shen Wuming came back to his senses, not forgetting that he was a married man.
"Wu Ming, the Supervisor's affairs are a bit troublesome. If you have any idea, please help."
Chu Pingshan was Shen Wuming's meal ticket. He had already come forward, so Shen Wuming naturally couldn't refuse.
He could only follow Cao Zhuyu to supervise the construction department.
After he left, the entire Shoutinghou Mansion was in a boil.
What is so lovable about this Shen Wuming?
First he captured Chu Youyi, one of the four beauties in Zhongshan, and then let Cao Juyu, the second of the four beauties, take such initiative?
Cao Juyu, who has always been proud, is a rising star in Zhongshan officialdom.
